review.reason: This group makes several bounded, substantive improvements by replacing static defaults with parameterized values across multiple warehouse connectors. This could help users and operators tune performance and compatibility without editing source. The change does not demonstrate broader architectural risk reduction or adoption metrics.
review.posthog_relevance: These variables control S3/Snowflake/BigQuery/Databricks/Redshift batch export behavior. Configuration flexibility can aid reliability and compatibility but requires downstream consumers to use them.
review.uncertainty: Without seeing how other modules consume BATCH_EXPORT_* and whether configuration actually propagates, the realized benefit remains unverified.
